mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotent_record (id, idempotent_key, biz_type, biz_id, status, expire_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{idempotentKey}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{status}, #{expireTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, idempotent_key, biz_type, biz_id, status, expire_time, create_time FROM idempotent_record WHERE idempotent_key = #{idempotentKey} FOR UPDATE
